title: Client Block Rule
description: Specifies a culling rule for block face visibility.

cull_against_full_and_opaque.title: Cull Against Full And Opaque
cull_against_full_and_opaque.description: If set to false, then culling against full and opaque blocks will not be considered.

condition.title: Rule Condition
condition.description:
Values:
• Default: The condition will succeed if the neighbor is a full and opaque block.
• Same block: The condition wil succeed if the neighbor block as the same identifier.
• Same block permutation: The condition will succeed if the neighbor block has the same identifier and is the exact same permutation.
• Same culling layer: The condition will succeed if if the neighbor block shares the same culling_layer as the block being occluded, defined in the geometry component.

client_block_rule_geometry_part.title: Client Block Rule Geometry Part
client_block_rule_geometry_part.description: Specifies a geometry part for culling.
